notes.title: The Adventures of Mr. Poop global update!!!
notes.notes:
[h3]Today we're releasing an update that will bring a lot of joy and fun:

- Added a [u]FREE DLC[/u] "Expedition to Mars"
- Added the ability to [u]PLAY WITH A FRIEND[/u] (in the DLC only)
- Changes have been made to the first winter level, it has been slightly simplified

We wish you luck and enjoy the game ːwinter2019happybulbː!!!

For all questions and suggestions, as well as in finding in-game bugs, please write to us by mail: [b]bogilom.games@gmail.com[/b][/h3]
